description: Given an employer name (Microsoft, JPMorgan Chase, Goldman Sachs, Salesforce, USAA, Boeing, etc.), returns whether the employer has a matching-gift program for 501(c)(3)s, the match rate, annual cap, platform (Benevity, YourCause, Bright Funds, Cybergrants) and a source note; entries checked against the employer's own page carry as_of and source_url. Some employers have no standard match (for example Amazon, or ExxonMobil, whose program covers colleges only). Always tell the donor to confirm current terms with their employer. Without an exact match, returns self-serve discovery instructions.
name: lookup_employer_match
title: Employer matching-gift lookup
